programInfo.name: Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science

description: The Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science at UDSM is a rigorous four-year programme designed to produce highly skilled professionals capable of analyzing and managing risk in insurance, finance, and related fields. The programme combines mathematics, statistics, economics, and finance with practical actuarial applications.

years.title: Foundation Year
years.description: Build a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and economics.
years.focus: Mathematical foundations and introduction to actuarial concepts

years.title: Core Actuarial Foundation
years.description: Deep dive into probability, statistics, and financial mathematics.

years.title: Advanced Actuarial Methods
years.description: Apply actuarial techniques to insurance and financial products.
years.focus: Applied actuarial modeling and professional practice

years.title: Specialization & Research
years.description: Specialize in advanced topics and complete a research project.
years.focus: Advanced actuarial practice, research, and industry preparation

progressionRequirements.requirement: Pass all Year 1 courses with a minimum GPA of 2.0
Pass all Year 2 courses, minimum GPA of 2.5, and pass AS 201
Pass all Year 3 courses, minimum GPA of 2.5, and demonstrate competency in actuarial modeling

graduationRequirements.description: Minimum of 120 credit hours across all four years
All AS-coded courses must be passed with a C or higher
Submit and defend a final year research project (AS 404)
Achieve a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5 to graduate

skillsDeveloped.description: Build and analyze mathematical models for risk and uncertainty
Apply statistical methods to real-world insurance and financial data
Master time value of money, annuities, and financial instruments
Use R, Python, and Excel for actuarial analysis and modeling
Identify, assess, and manage financial and insurance risks
Communicate complex actuarial concepts to diverse audiences
